MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for Default Prove-Up Hearing this day.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Maureen Howard.
Thomas Caudill, Esq. for Plaintiff: Patelco Credit Union.
Plaintiff's Witness: Melvin Bell, present, was sworn and direct examined.
After hearing the testimony and evidence presented, the Court rules in favor of the Plaintiff and against the Defaulted Defendant: Matthew Ugo Ressio as follows:
Damages $26,861.77
Prejudgment Interest $1,545.60
Attorney's Fees $1,950.00
Costs $416.00, for a total of $30,773.37
Judgment signed in open court.
